recommendation: Keep this fix as-is. No further core FHIR change is recommended for FHIR-39318 unless the work group wants a broader editorial rewrite of the already-applied named-query explanation.
issue_request: FHIR-39318 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to clarify named queries: a query has a single output parameter named "result" of type Bundle, an invariant should enforce that, the redundant OperationDefinition.parameter comment should be removed, search-parameter scope and support should be clarified, named queries should be described as searches invoked by _query rather than $operation, parameter order/repetition should be explicit, and named queries should be distinguished from custom SearchParameter definitions.
initial_application: Git commit 0c731f1d46ea8b8785e84141832ec9f570a92a26 applied most of the issue by adding the named-query narrative, boundary text, invariant opd-7, and invariant examples. It did not remove the old OperationDefinition.parameter comment, and the same stale comment was also still present on OperationDefinition.parameter.part.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists operationdefinition=OperationDefinition, so the edited StructureDefinition is in the current core build. The current OperationDefinition narrative already states that named queries are searches, cannot use the $operation mechanism, have a single Bundle result parameter, allow parameter repetition as specified, treat _query position as non-order-dependent, and include common/resource search parameters as in scope but not necessarily supported. The originating Zulip thread and FHIR-I minutes support the Jira disposition and did not reveal conflicting later guidance.
reconciliation: Removed the stale comments from OperationDefinition.parameter and OperationDefinition.parameter.part in source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml, leaving the authoritative opd-7 invariant and narrative to express the current named-query result rule.
source_changes: source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml: removed the obsolete query-definition comment from OperationDefinition.parameter.
source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml: removed the same obsolete query-definition comment from OperationDefinition.parameter.part.
